data.name: Super Monkey
targeting_extra: Robo Monkey second attack has own targeting (must differ from first)
Sun Temple/Dark Knight special options: uncertain
data.crosspath_rule: Standard BTD6: one path to tier 5, a second path up to tier 2, third path locked at 0.

1.name: Laser Blasts
1.text: Pierce +1, projectile size 2->5, Energy damage (pops Frozen, cannot pop Purple). Line of sight slightly elevated.

1.name: Plasma Blasts
1.text: Attack speed +50%, size 5->6, Plasma damage (pops Lead).

1.name: Sun Avatar
1.text: Sun blasts replace plasma: 3 projectiles per shot within 30 deg, +4 pierce each, 2x projectile speed.

1.name: Sun Temple
1.text: Single sunbeam, pops all bloon types. On purchase sacrifices all towers in Sun Avatar range (except Paragons/Heroes/Powers). Sacrifice benefits per category (Primary/Military/Magic/Support) start at $10,001 sacrificed, increase every $5,000, max at $50,001; only the 3 highest-value categories apply. Exact per-category benefits not captured.

1.name: True Sun God
1.text: Sunbeam damage 5->15. Sacrifices all towers in range again; second set of benefits stacks with Temple's; can receive from all four categories at once.

2.name: Robo Monkey
2.text: Pierce 4->5, second simultaneous attack copy with its own (different) targeting, crit shot every 15-20 shots for +9 damage.

2.name: Tech Terror
2.text: Ability: 2600 damage to up to 2000 bloons in 70 radius, all bloon types, hits Camo, cd 45s; every 3rd use +50% (3900). Main pierce +2, Plasma damage. With Knockback: ability applies -24x speed for 0.2s to survivors (not BADs/bosses).

2.name: The Anti-Bloon
2.text: Ability dmg 2600->10400 (3rd use 15600), radius 70->120, cd 45->30s. Main attack dmg 1->5, crit 10->50, pierce 7->12, range 72->82, crit every 13-17 shots, damage type Plasma->Normal.

3.name: Knockback
3.text: Hit bloons knocked back for 0.5s: MOAB-class at 70% speed, Ceramic/Lead at 40% speed, others move backwards at 25% speed. Not BADs/bosses.

3.name: Ultravision
3.text: Targets Camo, range +3, +1 damage to Camo, Camo Priority targeting.

3.name: Dark Knight
3.text: Blades: +2 MOAB damage, pierce 1->4, radius 2->4; knockback slows Ceramic/Lead to 10%. Activated ability Darkshift: move tower to any valid location within its range (cooldown not captured).

3.name: Dark Champion
3.text: Range 53->57, attack speed x2 alternating hands, Darkshift mapwide. Blades dmg 1->2, MOAB bonus 2->3, Camo bonus 1->2, +2 Ceramic, pops all types, pierce 4->8, size 5, ricochet to nearest bloon after 0.1s up to 8 times.

3.name: Legend of the Night
3.text: Passive Black Hole: on a leak, prevents all life loss (not boss bloons) for 8s; cd 180s, no initial cd, max 2/round, freezes when sold and does not reset on rebuy. Main attack dmg 2->10, Ceramic +2->+4, MOAB +3->+25, Camo +2->+4, pierce +8, jumps +15.
